explanation: Variadic templates are a feature introduced in C++11 that allow templates to accept an arbitrary number of template parameters, including types and non-type values. They enable writing highly flexible and generic code, such as tuple implementations, parameter forwarding, and compile-time computations. Variadic templates are fundamental for modern C++ metaprogramming, facilitating code reuse and type safety without resorting to preprocessor macros.
keywords: Variadic Templates, C++ parameter pack, non-type template parameters
